review_notes: Read the whole file. Found two repeated-machinery patterns: (1) the same valuation-estimate-on-inverse-powers argument in LiesOverVal.intCl_le and in hA of eq_of_center_eq; (2) a verbatim duplicate of the "Galois-fixed elements come from the base field" proof in under_center_eq (hfix) and exists_algebraMap_eq_of_fixed. Other near-repetitions (the `hy` 4-line blocks, residue-multiplication `e3/e4` blocks, hs0/hsres checks) were judged too short or routine. Not compiled; the proposed lemma statements are sketches and untested (the shared lemma in finding 1 does not need k ≥ 1 because Valuation.map_sum_lt is applied with a trivially true empty-sum case, but this is unverified).

findings.problem: Both proofs do the same nontrivial argument: from a relation x^k * u = -∑_{i<k} c_i x^i with c_i in the base ring, multiply by x⁻¹^k to turn the sum into ∑ c_i * x⁻¹^(k-i) (the calc with (x*x⁻¹)^i and pow_add, Finset.sum_congr, mul_assoc), then bound its valuation below 1 using v(c_i) ≤ 1, v(x⁻¹) < 1, 1 ≤ k-i, Valuation.map_sum_lt and pow_lt_one₀. In intCl_le it is done with u = 1 (lines 200-223, producing key/hlt); in eq_of_center_eq it is redone with u = aeval x (truncQ p k) (lines 295-313, huk and the following calc). The two blocks differ only in variable names and in which valuation ring is used.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma before intCl_le, e.g.
`theorem valuation_lt_one_of_pow_mul_eq {V : ValuationSubring L} {x u : L} (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hy : V.valuation x⁻¹ < 1) (k : ℕ) (c : ℕ → L) (hc : ∀ i, V.valuation (c i) ≤ 1) (h : x ^ k * u = -∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, c i * x ^ i) : V.valuation u < 1`.
Proof sketch: u = (x^k*u) * x⁻¹^k, rewrite with h, neg_mul, Finset.sum_mul, show each summand equals c i * x⁻¹^(k-i) (the existing calc), apply Valuation.map_neg and Valuation.map_sum_lt with the existing gcongr/pow_lt_one₀ step. Uses: in intCl_le take u = 1, k = n, c i = algebraMap _ L (p.coeff i) (coefficients bounded by h.valuation_le_one_of_mem_baseRing (p.coeff i).2), with h obtained from heval via eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (after mul_one), and conclude with `simp` on V.valuation 1 < 1. In eq_of_center_eq, hA k hk becomes `valuation_lt_one_of_pow_mul_eq hx0 hy k (fun i => algebraMap _ L (p.coeff i)) (fun i => hV'.valuation_le_one_of_mem_baseRing (p.coeff i).2) (X_pow_mul_aeval_truncQ p x hp k)`, and the hk hypothesis (which is unused in the original proof) can be dropped or kept. The hy block (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀) could also be folded into the lemma by taking `x ∉ V` instead.
findings.benefit: Removes ~20 lines of intricate inverse-power/geometric rearrangement that is currently maintained twice, makes the common idea (an integral-type relation forces v(u)<1 when v(x)>1) explicit and named, and shrinks both intCl_le and eq_of_center_eq to their distinctive parts.
